description: This file defines the MessageSourceService interface, which extends MutableMessageSource and provides methods to retrieve and set message sources and obtain localized messages within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: MessageSourceService
classes.description: An interface for a service that extends the capabilities of MutableMessageSource by providing methods to manage message sources and retrieve localized messages.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message corresponding to the given code from the current user's locale.

methods.name: getActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Returns the currently active message source service.

methods.name: setActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Sets the message source service that will provide messages.

methods.name: getMessageSources
methods.description: Returns the set of available message sources.
